comment: Declarative registry of every vendored 3D source. This file is the SINGLE place licence facts are written; build-manifests.mjs copies them verbatim into each assets/packs/<id>/pack.json and into THIRD_PARTY_ASSETS.md, so the three never drift. licenseQuote is text read AT THE SOURCE during retrieval (LICENSE file in the download, or the licence block on the page) — not paraphrased.

packs.notes: Free 'Standard' tier ships 2 of the 6 base bodies (Superhero Female/Male) + 8 hairstyles; the remaining bases are paywalled in the Source tier. Hairstyles taken from the 'Rigged to Head Bone' variant so they bind to the UBC head bone. The animation library ships as a rigged mesh + 43 clips; we keep the clips only (mesh-less shared AnimationLibrary, technique.md canonical-rig rule).

packs.displayName: VRoid Studio CC0 sample models (base bodies)
packs.attribution: VRoidプロジェクト (VRoid Project / pixiv Inc.)
packs.licenseQuote: OpenGameArt licence block on the submission page: CC0. Corroborated by the VRM's own in-file metadata: extensions.VRM.meta.licenseName == "CC0" (read back by audit.mjs after slimming), with otherLicenseUrl granting redistribution=allow, modification=allow, corporate_commercial_use=allow, credit=unnecessary.
packs.notes: PART-MIXER PROHIBITION: VRoid meshes are shipped ONLY as fixed, whole avatars. They must never enter the part-mixer — pixiv's VRoid Studio guideline bars apps that generate/output models from deformed or recombined VRoid meshes (jrpg-bases.md killer clause). AvatarSample_D/E/F/G from the same OGA bundle are deliberately NOT shipped: their in-file licenseName is "Other" (not "CC0"), and at 26.7k-34.4k tris / 417-498 joints they blow the Quest budget with no safe decimation path.

packs.attribution: Polygonal Mind (Daniel Garcia / ToxSam and team) — https://github.com/PolygonalMind/100Avatars
packs.licenseQuote: CCLicense.md at the repo root is the verbatim Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International Public License text ("https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode"). README.md adds a non-licence request: "The only thing we're asking, is not to sell this avatars without any major modification."
packs.notes: AT-SOURCE CORRECTION: the research brief called this collection CC0; the repository's own licence file is CC-BY-4.0, so it ships as Tier-2 with mandatory attribution. DISCLOSURE from the repo README: "Later on we started to rig them properly using Mixamo" — the skeletons are Mixamo auto-rigger output, redistributed by the copyright holder. Flagged for legal review; kept as an IMPORTER TEST CORPUS (VRM 0.x ingest, viseme discovery, licence-metadata surfacing), not as shipped player avatars.

notShipped.reason: BLENDER REQUIRED. Verified by listing both archives the page offers: modular_rpg_characters.7z = 53 files / 2 folders, of which the only geometry is human_female.blend + human_male.blend (the other 51 are textures/*.png + READ_ME.txt); modular_rpg_characters_ik_rig_for_animating.7z = animations_bake_human_female.blend + animations_bake_human_male.blend + READ_ME.txt. No FBX/glTF/DAE export exists anywhere in either download. Blender is not installed in this environment, so there is no honest conversion path; skipped rather than faked.

BLENDER REQUIRED. Verified by archive listing: basemesh_a1_human_yw_by_girush_2.7z = 8 files, geometry is baseMesh_A1_(human_YW)_by_Girush.blend (+ its .blend1 autosave) and the rest are PNG maps + readme.txt. No exported mesh format.

WRONG RIG — measured, not assumed. The pack downloads fine (lib/itch-fetch.sh, free upload, LICENSE.txt inside reads 'License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0)'), but Animations/gltf/KayKit_AnimatedCharacter_v1.2.glb is the blocky 'PrototypePete' demo character on a 6-JOINT rig, while the KayKit Adventurers/Skeletons characters we ship are a 41-bone rig. Its 30 clips therefore cannot drive the shipped characters without a rig-aware retarget (Blender / a BoneMap authored in the Godot editor). The 76-clip library already extracted from the Adventurers pack is on the CORRECT rig and covers the social poses this room needs (Idle, Cheer, Sit_Chair_*, Sit_Floor_*, Lie_*, Interact, PickUp, Throw, Walking/Running variants). Only Wave/Dance/Climbing/Hop/Roll are unique to the standalone pack — recorded as a follow-up for a Blender-equipped machine rather than shipped as clips nothing can play.

No scriptable download. Unlike every other Quaternius pack this one has no itch.io listing; the site's only download button opens a Google Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MIRQXLfTd21HMI5rwOb6Xy0rv0xv1m8b), which cannot be fetched deterministically without an account/API key. Its coverage overlaps Universal Base Characters + Modular Outfits + KayKit Adventurers, so nothing is lost functionally.

Sketchfab's Download API requires an OAuth/account token (the 'archives' field is null unauthenticated), and link-audit.md rates the collection provenance-poisoned — every candidate needs per-model IP vetting. Out of scope for an unauthenticated pipeline.
